relationships.subject: cyclodextrins
relationships.evidence_quote: CD-pretreatment significantly reduced mustard oil-induced acute neurogenic vasodilatation in the mouse ear

key_findings: Topical cyclodextrins reduce TRPV1- and TRPA1-agonist-evoked nocifensive behavior, mechanical (not thermal) hyperalgesia and neurogenic vasodilatation in mice.
Effects accompany tissue cholesterol depletion, reversible by cholesterol loading.
